channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Australia urges global cooperation on climate, AI checks and international law
item.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese urged nations to collaborate on climate action, artificial intelligence oversight, and restoring international law at the United Nations General Assembly in New Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese underlined the need for countries to work together to address the climate crisis, emerging technologies such as AI, and the breakdown of international rules, at the United Nations General Assembly on Thursday.

item.title: UN General Assembly debate Day 3
item.description: As the high-level debate enters a fourth day, The Takeaway looks back at key highlights on Thursday, with Israeli and Palestinian leaders presenting divergent views on the Middle East conflict and their counterparts from across the world weighing in on the far-reaching impacts of the ongoing crisis in Gaza and the occupied West Bank. UN General Assembly debate Day 3.

item.title: As Deadline Looms, Ex-US Marine Desperately Seeks Brother At Afghan Refugee Camp In Qatar
item.description: A former US Marine spent days in Doha trying to meet his brother at an Afghan refugee camp that will close on 30 September. The camp houses 2,000 refugees whose planned transfer to the United States was halted by a presidential executive order. The inmates face an uncertain future. A former US Marine has spent days trying to see his brother at a camp in Qatar holding Afghan refugees in limbo after plans to bring them to the United States were blocked by a presidential executive order.

item.title: Deadly New Strikes In Russia's War On Ukraine As Spillover Concerns Mount
item.description: Russia kept up its pattern of relentless attacks on Kyiv, killing a 14-year-old boy and injuring seven other people in a drone strike on an apartment building in the capital on September 25, Ukrainian authorities said. Deadly New Strikes In Russia's War On Ukraine As Spillover Concerns Mount.

item.title: What Makes Russia's New Jet-Powered Drone So Dangerous?
item.description: RFE/RL takes apart a Russian Geran-4 drone to uncover what makes the jet-powered unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) faster, harder to intercept, and capable of operating deep inside Ukraine -- from its turbojet engine and advanced camera to foreign-made communications and navigation components. What Makes Russia's New Jet-Powered Drone So Dangerous?

item.title: ‘We’re going to win. We have no other choice’
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told the UN General Assembly that Israel’s strikes on Iran are a matter of national survival. He dismissed West Bank violence as the work of a handful of juvenile delinquents and called accusations of genocide in Gaza the greatest lie of the century. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu used his address to the UN General Assembly to defend Israel’s strikes against Iran as a matter of national survival and describe the violence in the West Bank as the work of few “juvenile delinquents” and reject accusations of genocide in Gaza as “the greatest lie of the century.”.

item.title: Palestinian existence under threat, Abbas tells UN, warning of ‘another Nakba’
item.description: Israeli policies now threaten “the very life and existence of the Palestinian people on their homeland”, Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas told the UN General Assembly on Thursday, urging the world not to allow “another Nakba”. Palestinian existence under threat, Abbas tells UN, warning of ‘another Nakba’.

item.title: World leaders approve new declaration to tackle rising sea levels
item.description: Sea level rise is among the most visible consequences of global warming, but for some countries, it is an imminent existential threat. World leaders meet Thursday to adopt a new declaration and debate the best ways to strengthen international cooperation and support vulnerable low-lying nations most at risk. World leaders tackle sea level rise, a stark marker of climate change.

item.title: UN General Assembly debate Day 2
item.description: This edition of UN News's The Takeaway recaps key highlghts at the UN General Assembly on Wednesday, including focus on the war in Ukraine and a renewed push by African countries for Security Council reform. UN General Assembly debate Day 2.

item.title: US Pushes To Turn Armenia-Azerbaijan Transit Deal Into Investment Opportunity
item.description: The Trump administration is trying to turn a US-brokered opening between Armenia and Azerbaijan into something more tangible: a transport corridor linking Central Asia and the South Caucasus with Western markets -- and an investment opportunity for American companies. US Pushes To Turn Armenia-Azerbaijan Transit Deal Into Investment Opportunity.

item.title: Cambodia an early warning of China’s AI surveillance exports
item.description: Chinese investment has long been a cornerstone of development policy for many Southeast Asian nations. From roads and buildings to green energy that helps countries keep up with global environmental regulations, Beijing’s investment has created significant development opportunities. But it has also provided a safety net for authoritarian governments seeking to consolidate power while limiting [] Cambodia an early warning of China’s AI surveillance exports.

item.title: Five Afghan Family Members Die Of Thirst While Trying To Reach Iran
item.description: An Afghan migrant reported that his stepmother and four sisters died An Afghan migrant has told RFE/RL's Radio Azadi that his stepmother and four sisters died of thirst and hunger while attempting a dangerous journey to Iran after economic hardship forced the family to leave Afghanistan again. Five Afghan Family Members Die Of Thirst While Trying To Reach Iran.

item.title: Delcy Rodríguez poses with Trump in New York as Maduro languishes in jail nearby
item.description: Venezuela’s interim president hails ‘historic meeting’ and does not say whether she will visit snatched predecessorVenezuela’s interim president, Delcy Rodríguez, has celebrated a “historic” meeting with Donald Trump in New York, posing for a smiley photo with the US president, less than nine months after he ordered the abduction of her boss, Nicolás Maduro. Delcy Rodríguez poses with Trump in New York as Maduro languishes in jail nearby.
